plain: Made worse; in law, made more serious by added harm

webster.text: Increased in severity or enormity; made worse; exaggerated.

example.quote: I shall show, too, that they must feel it in an aggravated degree.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, New York Convention, June 28, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
